Spider Guard Mastery By Michael Langhi.overview: Michael Langhi's gi spider guard, three parts (about 1.5 hours). Part 1 covers spider guard basics and the scissor sweep from spider. Part 2 covers De La Riva / spider combinations into the single leg. Part 3 covers spider to X guard sweeps and balancing between spider, De La Riva and reverse De La Riva.
Spider Guard Mastery By Michael Langhi.for: Gi open guard players, especially lighter ones.

Standing2Ground Positional Dominance and.overview: John Danaher's Standing2Ground volume 2 on positional takedowns and scrimmage wrestling (your copy has 8 files; the publisher lists 7 sections). It covers positional takedowns, re-shots (the throw-by and underhook throw-by), the theory and practice of scoring takedowns in jiu-jitsu (including a special study of the 2-on-1 as a back take tool), short offence, takedown defence (defending leg tackles, the belly whizzer against the single leg), positional defence and standing escapes, and standing submissions (including the limp leg takedown defence).
Standing2Ground Positional Dominance and.for: No-gi jiu-jitsu players who want to win the scrambles after the first shot.
